newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Skandia faces internal row - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Skandia faces internal row - paper.

text.p: Two top Skandia officials are headed for a showdown over the fate of Assurance and Financial Services (AFS), the insurance company's foreign division, a report in Swedish business daily Dagens Industri said.
Jan Carendi, vice chief executive office, told the newspaper that "it's not best for the shareholders" if AFS remains part of Skandia.
But new chief executive Lars-Eric Petersson wants to keep the company intact, the paper said in its Thursday edition.
The division is Skandia's most expansive and dynamic.
In the United States, premium income has grown about 45 percent each year. Total assets are growing 50 percent a year and at the beginning of the year stood at more than 88 billion crowns.
